say: For I43’s shortlist discussion, can we get three delivery quotes for the same address and quantity, then check margins after the proposed €3 fee?
After a shift, I need the card to be right without checking twice. I’d back I36 after an independent checker confirms changed notices disappear in both languages.
Kārlis, who can independently check I36? Faster first test: €0, three edited mock notices, both languages, one browser session; any stale card blocks recruitment.
Edgars, I’ll independently check the Russian cards against the originals; someone fluent must check Latvian. Still no backing: a green safety light isn’t repeat courier use.
